title: Mall world dream last night
content: Starts off parking my truck in the parking lot. Packed full of cars but no one walking around. Enter mall via Sears. Take escalator down to first floor, exit Sears into the mall. I can now see it is three stories tall, but I stick to the first floor. People are walking around now. Lots of little shops and stores but nothing really stands out. Get to the other end of the store and enter a big box Costco or Walmart type store, buy the isles are super wide, shelves very tall. I enter into a frozen food section and pace back and forth looking at ice cream. Apparently this is why I am at the mall. To get a huge bucket of ice cream. I spend some time looking at all the flavors, can't decide what to get and end up not getting any ice cream and decided to check out candy instead. Head to candy isle. One side is all candy bars, but like big packs of them, 20x at least. The other side of the isle is just tons of fireworks. People seem to be buying a lot of fire works. Someone lights one off in the store. Decide to get out of here before police come. Back in the mall I see this dark area ive never seen before. I get closer and it's sort of an arcade bar, everyone is drinking beer and eating fried foods. It is all midevil theme. I see these cool decorated tables where people are playing d&d. A number of groups are in full cosplay. There is this three ring stage area in the middle of the tables. This is where groups can live action role play their d&d encounters. I thought it was so cool and couldn't wait to come back. The arcade was some game I've never seen before. The players were moving peices around a board and it would cause the video game to do things. I didn't know how it worked but was intrigued. Decided I needed to get going and headed back to my truck. Got to the other end of the mall and it was totally empty. Security guard noticed I was lost. Told me the way back to Sears, but kept following me chatting as I walked. He told me that this was the "Southside mall" in Michigan, and was south of one of the Great lakes. He also mentioned a famous movie was filmed at the mall, but I had never heard of it. Also said the cops were very relaxed and would let you get away will all sorts of stuff, but implied that that was only if you were white. Got freaked out by the racism and walked away. Took escalator back up and realized I only explored one floor. But decided to get going. Saw my truck right away but all the other cars in the parking lot were gone. The dream continues outside the mall. I end up camping in the woods but also end up in a multi day traffic jam. At some point I turn into a different person, located in LA. My backpack was stolen and it had drugs in it. I needed to get the drugs back for the people I owed money too. Everything is pretty blurry here, but the drug cartel was run by Jewish mobsters. I was able to replace the drugs and did the handoff at some strip mall in a part of LA call "Tourance". Leaving a lot of mall related details out but you get the picture.
